defect: SetConnection calls DBInstanceCache::CreateInstance, which throws 'Instance with path ... already exists' when a second ODBC connection opens the same cached database file.
reason: The added CreateInstance call is exactly what the fix replaces with GetOrCreateInstance; the throwing behaviour lives in db_instance_cache.cpp.

defect: The new ArrowMetadataGetValue declares an unused local int64_t size, which breaks the build when warnings are treated as errors.
reason: The fix only deletes that unused variable added by this new file, and its message states the warnings-as-errors build failed.

defect: The fix adds NaT-to-NULL handling for datetime objects and restructures TransformPythonValue into a switch over object types.
reason: The change only renamed the parameter from_pandas to nan_as_null; the missing NaT handling existed before it.

defect: The fix replaces 'virtual ~DictionaryCompressionState()' with '~DictionaryCompressionState() override', a clang-tidy style change.
reason: The destructor was virtual and correct either way; no other member uses override, so no compiler error results.

defect: The new ScanToDictionaryVector declares 'auto result_data = FlatVector::GetData<string_t>(result)' and never uses it, an unused variable that fails the warnings-as-errors build.
reason: The fix removes exactly this unused local introduced by the change, under the message 'warnings-as-errors'.

defect: The fix adds an explicit static_cast<idx_t>(row_id) when passing the signed row id to ScanToFlatVector, a tidy narrowing-conversion cleanup.
reason: The implicit row_t-to-idx_t conversion already existed in the previous call ScanToFlatVector(segment, result, result_idx, row_id, 1).

defect: The fix retunes the idle timeouts (0.5 s flush, then 9.5 s before ThreadIdle) and marks an exiting thread idle.
reason: This is a tuning of allocator flush timing; the 5 s idle wait added by the change is a policy choice, not a wrong result or crash.

defect: On this file the fix only reorders the log_type.hpp include after logging.hpp and drops the unused <functional> include.
reason: log_type.hpp itself includes logging.hpp, so the order is cosmetic; the missing log_type.hpp file is added by a different later commit, not by this fix.

defect: The fix makes PIVOT handle expressions around an aggregate (e.g. COALESCE(SUM(x), 0)) by replacing the inner aggregate with a column reference.
reason: The change only moved the catalog lookup to EntryLookupInfo; the mishandling of aggregate expressions in PIVOT predates it.

defect: On the header the fix only turns HashInternal from a static function taking idx_t& into a const member taking const idx_t; the real fix (hashes_v.Initialize(false, n)) is in the cpp.
reason: The faulty Initialize(approved_tuple_count) call already existed in the inline code this change moved, and the header signature change is cleanup.

defect: The new Windows GetWorkingDirectory calls SetCurrentDirectory(count, buffer) instead of GetCurrentDirectory and compares the return against count, so it does not compile/work and mishandles the terminating NUL.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added lines with GetCurrentDirectory and the correct length check.

defect: The fix corrects the typo 'cannot be references' to 'cannot be referenced' in the new BinderException message.
reason: A grammar fix in an error message is a documentation/style change, not a functional defect.

defect: The new escape-removal loop in AddValue calls escape_positions.front() right after pop() without checking the queue is non-empty, which is undefined behaviour once the last escape is consumed.
reason: The fix wraps the front() accesses in an !escape_positions.empty() check and an else-if, repairing exactly the loop this change added.

defect: The change moves the delimiter loop outermost in GenerateStateMachineSearchSpace, changing the order of sniffer candidates; the fix reverts the order and reworks RefineCandidates.
reason: This is same-day experimentation on sniffer heuristics; whether the reordered candidates actually produced wrong dialects cannot be told from the code.

defect: The fix makes CreateSchemaInfo::ToString emit 'CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS x;' instead of the invalid 'CREATE SCHEMA x IF NOT EXISTS;'.
reason: The wrong string already existed in the inline ToString of create_schema_info.hpp before this change moved it to a cpp file.

defect: The fix iterates table_filters->filters instead of table_filters after a concurrently merged branch changed table_filters into a TableFilterSet pointer.
reason: At this change table_filters was an unordered_map and the loop compiled; the break came from a later merge, as the fix message 'Fix merge issue' says.

defect: The fix adapts ReadCSVRelation::GetTableRef to a later read_csv API change (drop the delimiter argument, pass columns as a named parameter).
reason: The arguments matched the read_csv signature when the change was made; the fix follows an API change made four months later.

defect: The fix replaces the C-style cast (void *)(buffer + to_copy) with const_cast<data_ptr_t> and rewrites a comment.
reason: Cast style and comment wording are tidy/style changes; the direct-write logic is unchanged.

defect: The fix passes col_ref.alias when ReplaceWithBoundReference creates a BoundReferenceExpression, so ALIAS() in pushed-down filters returns the column name.
reason: The previous recursive version also created BoundReferenceExpression(return_type, 0) without the alias, so the defect predates this iterator refactor.

defect: The new duckdb_create_value switches on DUCKDB_TYPE_INT64 and DUCKDB_TYPE_INT32 and calls Value::INT32, none of which exist (the enumerators are DUCKDB_TYPE_BIGINT/INTEGER), so the file does not compile.
reason: The fix renames exactly these cases to DUCKDB_TYPE_BIGINT/INTEGER and constructs the int32 Value directly; checking the names needs duckdb.h and value.hpp.

defect: The fix heap-allocates data_locations/mask_locations of size count instead of fixed STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE stack arrays, so counts above the vector size no longer overflow.
reason: The fixed-size arrays existed before; the change only renamed DeserializeIntoVector to RowOperations::HeapGather.

defect: The new RemoveInequalityCandidate copies the child join's comparisons into the parent DelimJoin by index without checking that the parent has as many conditions or that they refer to the same columns, and keeps looping after finding a parent, so it can index out of bounds or rewrite unrelated conditions.
reason: The fix adds the condition-count check, the column correspondence checks via reverse_proj_or_agg_map and the break, all in code this change added.

defect: The fix makes TopNHeap::Reduce check and compact heap_data instead of payload_chunk.
reason: Reduce already tested payload_chunk.size() and copied payload_chunk before this change, which only renamed MaxHeapSize to HeapAllocSize and capped the allocation.

defect: The new PushdownUnnest only looks at the first table binding of each filter (dereferencing bindings.begin() under a D_ASSERT of at most one binding), so a filter with several or no bindings is wrongly pushed below the UNNEST or dereferences an end iterator.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this first-binding check with a loop over all bindings, as the failing test required.

defect: The fix changes TransformIdentifierColId to take ParseResult& instead of optional_ptr<ParseResult> while resolving merge conflicts.
reason: It follows a later transformer API change merged in from another branch; the code was consistent with the API when written.

defect: The fix changes TransformTableNameIdentifierOrStringLiteral to take ParseResult& while resolving merge conflicts.
reason: The change was only reformatting, and the fix adapts to a later signature change from a merge, not a defect.

defect: OuterJoinMarker::Scan indexes found_match with gstate.scan_position, which is set to 0 and never advanced, so every chunk after the first checks the wrong match flags and full/right outer joins emit wrong rows.
reason: The fix replaces gstate.scan_position with the scan's current_row_index and drops the dead field, both introduced in this new file.

defect: The fix repairs bogus results of normal aggregates after a distinct aggregate by using payload_idx + payload_cnt as expression index in Sink, and replaces the payload_chunk.Slice with Reference.
reason: The payload_expr_idx indexing in Sink and Finalize predates this change, and the Slice with a null selection vector is an identity slice, equivalent to the Reference the fix uses.

defect: The fix qualifies Value and LogicalType with duckdb:: in the Unwrap helpers and vectors to fix Windows build errors.
reason: The unqualified Value and LogicalType names in these helpers already existed before this change, which only switched them to references.

defect: The fix makes cte_references and cte_bindings shared and inherits them from the parent binder so recursive CTE references inside subqueries can be bound.
reason: Subquery binders already could not see the CTE binding before this change, so the non-shared counter added here causes no failure of its own until inheritance exists.

defect: The fix stores CTE bindings as shared_ptr (and the counter as shared_ptr<index_t>) so child binders can inherit them.
reason: Before this change CTE bindings already lived in the per-binder bindings map and were not inherited, so the subquery failure predates it.

defect: The fix adds '&& !defined(DISABLE_BUILTIN_EXTENSIONS)' to the JSON extension guard.
reason: DISABLE_BUILTIN_EXTENSIONS did not exist at this change; it was added later (74d716d) and the JSON case was missed there.

defect: On this file the fix only reflows the constructor initializer lists; the CASE string-ownership fix itself is in vector_helpers.cpp.
reason: The vector.cpp hunk of the fix is pure formatting and repairs nothing in the lines this change touched.

defect: The new templated _case_loop<const char *> copies raw string pointers from res_true/res_false into the result, so the CASE result points at strings owned by temporary input vectors (the removed SetValue-based Case copied them).
reason: The fix adds StringCase, which copies each chosen string into the result's string_heap, repairing the VARCHAR path this change introduced; seeing the ownership rule needs vector.cpp.

defect: The fix rewrites comments and builds the same CatalogTransaction(MAX_TRANSACTION_ID, commit_id) through named locals.
reason: The behaviour of VerifyExistenceOfDependency is unchanged; the fix is comments and restructuring only.

defect: The new TransformPrefixExpression applies the prefix operators left to right, so the outermost prefix wraps the base first and e.g. 'NOT -x' becomes -(NOT x).
reason: The fix iterates the same prefix list in reverse, repairing the order of the loop this change added.

defect: The fix moves the inline GetEntry(CatalogType, const string &catalog, ...) that calls Catalog::GetEntry out of the header into catalog_entry_retriever.cpp to fix a compilation issue.
reason: The parent header already called Catalog::GetEntry inline with only a forward declaration and the includers did not change, so it cannot be told whether this rewrite caused the build break.

defect: The fix fills the GROUPING() function columns (grouping_values) in the empty-input grouping-set result and extends the column-count assertion.
reason: The empty-input special case ignored grouping functions before this change too; the change added null groups but did not create the omission.

defect: The new block-based Partition adds the leftover temp-buffer rows to block_counts after each input block, but only starts a new partition block when block_counts == block_capacity, so the count can step past the capacity and rows are written beyond the block.
reason: The fix replaces the equality check with 'block_count + TMP_BUF_SIZE > block_capacity', also checked after the cleanup, and removes the alignment assertion, all in logic this change introduced.

defect: The fix redesigns the parallel CSV test to compare full-buffer against variable-buffer reads instead of single- against multi-threaded reads.
reason: This is a test change after the reader redesign; the change itself only replaced std::endl and re-enabled a test case.
